revision: Think-only, at most ten fixed reusable source regions, programmable delay/reverb sends

changes: All application JavaScript, styles, test execution logic, engineering assertions, and format help are embedded in sampler.html.
Removed the optional service-worker file dependency.
Added a disposable instance of the same HTML for silent engineering checks.

Added FX / AUTOMATION in the main sequencer toolbar; moved send controls and lanes beneath it, retaining the reusable-chop editor in the arrangement. Panel visibility saves in workspace.automationOpen.
consolidation.candidateRenderSha256Scope: Historical software render from the earlier consolidation; not a native-browser checksum for this revision.

nativeChromeFix.cause: AudioBufferSourceNode.playbackRate is k-rate. Setting its value at a future note start within a render quantum left the beginning of that note at the default rate in Chrome.
nativeChromeFix.fix: Initialize each source playbackRate.value before scheduling start, in both arrangement and native-grid engines.
otherChanges: Test A/B controls remain available during locked test playback.
Exact arrangement grid and source-waveform monitor follow the shared audio clock.
WAV export recognizes arrangement events even with an empty native pattern.
Four new engineering regressions embedded in sampler.html.

similarityTargetRevision.requestedChange: Use a 70% similarity threshold against the original, adjustable upward later.
similarityTargetRevision.criterion: Rhythm-envelope correlation >= 0.70, plus existing format and level checks. Exact waveform errors stay in the reports as diagnostics.
